text:
Company: Stripe
Founded: 2010
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA / Dublin, Ireland
Founders: Patrick Collison, John Collison
Employees: ~8,000
Total Funding: $8.7B
Latest Round: Series I, $6.5B, March 2023
Latest Valuation: $50B (as of 2025 re-valuation)
Industry: Fintech / Payments
Key Products: Stripe Payments, Stripe Connect, Stripe Atlas, Stripe Treasury, Stripe Tax
Target Customers: Internet businesses, SaaS companies, marketplaces, platforms

Source: https://stripe.com/about
Date: 2025-01-XX
Title: Stripe About

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for the internet. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Headquartered in San Francisco and Dublin, the company aims to increase the GDP of the internet.
